verdict: Meta ads went dark this week; your lead pipeline has stalled.
narrative: Over the full 28-day window you received 72 leads at $8.58 per lead — a solid baseline. However, Meta advertising was inactive for 5 of the last 7 days, and leads dropped to zero in that stretch. Ads are being brought back live to restore pipeline flow this week. Your Google Business Profile held up through the disruption — 73 calls and 105 direction requests came in organically over the period, keeping some intake moving. Once paid ads are running consistently again, lead volume should recover toward the 28-day average.
